children: Hong Kong real estate developer's annual revenue declined year-over-year
Company cited challenging retail and industrial environment, offset by residential portfolio gains
Board recommended final dividend of HK$0.43 per share, total dividend HK$0.58 per share
Company plans to launch Wing Kwong Street/Sung On Street project in To Kwa Wan in 2026
Company says land bank should meet development needs over next few years
RETAIL AND INDUSTRIAL CHALLENGES - Co said rental revenue declined due to challenging conditions in retail and industrial sectors
RESIDENTIAL PORTFOLIO GAINS - Increased contributions from residential portfolio partially offset rental revenue decline
NEW PROJECT LAUNCHES - Co launched several new residential projects in Hong Kong during the year
